helpSupportContent:
Need assistance with MedScan?

You can ask your medical questions directly in our Virtual Doctor Chat tab.

For any other questions or technical support, contact us by email at: support@medscan.com
aboutContent:
MedScan is your smart pocket medical assistant.

Scan any medication to instantly identify its molecules, contraindications, and correct dosage.

Developed by healthcare and AI professionals to simplify the understanding of your treatments.
termsContent:
1. Educational and Informational Use
MedScan is a digital assistant tool designed to facilitate understanding of medications. Analyses and suggestions are generated by artificial intelligence for informational purposes.

2. No Medical Substitute
MedScan does not provide medical diagnoses and in no way replaces the advice of a physician or recommendations of a pharmacist. Always verify your prescriptions and dosages with a healthcare professional.

3. Medical Emergencies
The app is not an emergency service. In case of emergency or severe distress, immediately call your local emergency services (911, 112, or local dispatch).
privacyContent:
1. Identity Protection and Security
Your direct personal data (name, email address, account identifiers) is encrypted, strictly confidential, and is never sold or rented.

2. Contribution to Medical and Scientific Research
To advance pharmacological knowledge and treatment safety, MedScan may collaborate with partner research centers, universities, and healthcare organizations.
Under these partnerships, only strictly anonymized and aggregated statistical data (with no possibility of linking back to your identity) may be shared for scientific study and analysis.

3. Your Rights and Account Deletion
You retain full control: you can permanently delete your account and all associated data at any time from the Settings tab.
